summary: Church Leader Authentication and Content Edit Request System testing complete. Backend: 28/28 tests passed (100%). All church leader endpoints working correctly - self-registration (pending approval), admin-created accounts (auto-approved), login, profile, announcements, account approval/rejection. Choir content edit request system fully functional - album/song edit requests, admin approval/rejection with actual content updates.
passed_tests: GET /api/church-leader/me - Authenticated returns profile with church details
POST /api/church-leader/announcements - Creates announcement with church_id from session
GET /api/church-leader/accounts - Returns all church leader accounts
POST /api/choir/albums/{album_id}/edit-request - Creates edit request for owned album
critical_code_review_comments: ChurchLeaderAccount model correctly includes church_id, name, email, password_hash, phone, role, status, approved_by, approved_at
Church leader self-registration creates account with status='pending', admin-created accounts have status='approved'
Church leader login correctly checks status='approved' before allowing login
Church leader session uses separate collection (church_leader_sessions) from choir sessions
ContentEditRequest model stores original_data and updated_data for audit trail
Album edit request correctly checks ownership using both singer_id and artist_id for backwards compatibility
Content edit approval applies updated_data to actual album/song document
Content edit rejection only updates request status without modifying content
SMS notifications are MOCKED - they log to database instead of sending real SMS
seed_data_creation: Test church leader accounts and edit requests created during pytest run with TEST_church_leader_* prefix. Cleanup runs after tests.

mocked_apis.SMS_notifications: MOCKED - SMS notifications log to database (sms_notifications collection) instead of sending real SMS. Provider field shows 'mock' and status shows 'mock_sent'

church_leader_auth.login: POST /api/church-leader/login - Returns session_token for approved accounts
church_leader_auth.profile: GET /api/church-leader/me - Returns account and church details

church_leader_announcements.create: POST /api/church-leader/announcements - Creates announcement for leader's church

church_leader_admin.list_accounts: GET /api/church-leader/accounts - Returns all church leader accounts

content_edit_requests.album_edit: POST /api/choir/albums/{album_id}/edit-request - Creates edit request for owned album
content_edit_requests.song_edit: POST /api/choir/songs/{song_id}/edit-request - Creates edit request for owned song
content_edit_requests.admin_list: GET /api/admin/content-edit-requests - Returns all edit requests with optional status filter
content_edit_requests.admin_approve: POST /api/admin/content-edit-requests/{id}/approve - Approves and applies changes to content

context_for_next_testing_agent: Church Leader Authentication and Content Edit Request System fully tested and working. Church leader accounts use separate session collection (church_leader_sessions). Content edit requests store original_data and updated_data for audit. Album ownership check uses both singer_id and artist_id for backwards compatibility. Test file: /app/tests/test_church_leader_content_edit.py. Previous iterations (1-9) context preserved.
